note: Company is an Indian flight-simulator training/MRO operator (address A-101, Dream Apartments, Plot-14, Sector-22, Delhi/Gurugram area) that imports simulator parts and used/faulty components from CAE Inc (Canada), Simulator Components Inc (USA), Parcop S.R.L. (Italy), Servers Fit (USA) and returns items for repair/exchange — i.e. its customs footprint is inbound. Declared HS 880211 (helicopters <=2000kg) and 880529 (other flight-simulator parts) — 88052900 does appear in its import records (e.g. BOL 9366444, 8809017), but 880211 was not observed in any visible row; HS is not a rejection ground per project rules. No export bill-of-lading with date/destination was found, so export_status = none_found rather than 'declared'. Domestic supply evidence is genuinely not public in the sources reachable within the tool budget — recorded as unknown, not as confirmed.
